items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 30:1
items.html: (To the question) One is the aspect of Joseph, which is his own aspect, and it is the aspect of the revelation of the direct light in the stature. And the second is the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, which is the aspect of the screen in it, upon which the coupling of striking is made with the direct light, which brings out ten Sefirot of returning light to clothe the direct light; and before ZA bestows the stature to the Nukva, it comes out first in ZA himself, upon the aspect of Benjamin included in the Yesod in himself; and afterwards he bestows that stature to the Nukva, namely, upon the screen in her. And then the Yesod of ZA is discerned only for the aspect of Joseph alone, namely, for the direct light, and the Yesod of the Nukva for the aspect of Benjamin alone, namely, the aspect of the returning light. (Item 76).
